notes.title: Patch
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Fixed issue where scenes do not start and the user is stuck
 Fix issue where battle doesn't end if the last character to act was Auto-Turned
 Fix issue where camera moves too fast
[/olist]

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Fixed Steam Leaderboard.  Compete for a high score.
Many bug-fixes.  
The game will exit as soon as an error occurs.

notes.title: Scale / Resolution update
notes.notes:
Added option to zoom-in permenantly (helpful for higher resolutions).
Added option to go fullscreen with lower resolutions (helps scale up the UI for high-resolution monitors)

notes.title: More Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fixed crashing that could appear with a game controller.
Fixed issue with one of the early missions crashing.

notes.title: Patched Patch
notes.notes: Resolved issue that came up with the last patch.
